name: Fredis Beleris - Après le § 4 - Am 4
title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2024
part_text: 4a. Criticises the double standards used in the follow-up given to petitions, which exponentially increased in 2024; regrets that petitions were closed or not discussed in the Committee on Petitions, although drafted with solid, high-profile legal and analytical arguments, complemented by supporting documents that clearly explained the data and facts regarding the multiple violations of EU law affecting thousands of citizens, such as in the case of the petition on the environmental consequences of constructing a cellulose processing facility in Galicia, which would be highly detrimental to public health, the environment and the economy of the Galician territory concerned, while at the same time, some other petitions, which clearly fell outside the remit of EU law were not only considered admissible but also discussed on their merits;
